svg.title: Ruflo self learning architecture
svg.desc: Six conceptual scenes: architecture, recall, execute, evaluate, retain and adapt. Feedback recorded in memory informs future routing. This is an illustration, not live telemetry or a claim of automatic model training.

g.text: Retrieve related context and prior outcomes.
Relevant experience informs the next task.
The router assigns work across the swarm.
Agents use tools, memory and LLM providers.
Check task results against explicit criteria.
Record success, failure and useful corrections.
Store useful trajectories and task feedback.
Memory makes experience available for recall.
Use retained feedback to inform future routing.
Evaluate the next result. Repeat the cycle.
